info.title: roadbeat Studio API — Pro — Content Operations
info.description:
Self-hosted headless CMS — Content Management & Publishing API

**Pro — Content Operations.** Environment management, preview API, content import and export jobs, bulk asset/content operations and saved views.

post.summary: Move many assets into a folder (or to the root)

201.description: Move outcome. `affected` counts the rows updated; unknown or foreign IDs come back in `notFound`. `operationId` reverses the move via `ops/{id}/undo`.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Delete many assets — to the trash by default, or permanently with `permanent`

201.description: Delete outcome. Without `force`, assets still referenced by content are reported in `skipped` instead of being deleted. A soft delete is undoable via `operationId`; a permanent delete is not.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Add tags to many assets (merged, duplicates ignored)

201.description: Tag outcome. Assets that already carried every tag are listed in `unchanged` rather than counted as affected.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Remove tags from many assets

201.description: Tag outcome. Assets that carried none of the given tags are listed in `unchanged`.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Get signed download URLs for many assets (for a client-side ZIP)

201.description: Per-asset metadata with a 10-minute signed URL each, plus the combined size. Raw storage keys are never returned.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

201.description: Success. JSON responses are wrapped in the standard envelope: `{ "data": ... }`, with optional `meta` (e.g. pagination) on list endpoints.

meta.description: Optional metadata (pagination, counts) — present on list endpoints

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Summarise a selection of assets before acting on it

201.description: Counts and size of the selection, broken down by MIME type and folder, plus which assets content still references.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

200.description: The 50 most recent bulk operations of the organization, newest first.

get.summary: Get one recorded bulk operation, including its undo snapshot

200.description: The requested audit entry; 404 when unknown to the organization.

post.summary: Reverse a recorded bulk operation

200.description: How many items were restored. 400 when the operation was already undone or has no before-state (permanent deletes).

get.summary: List soft-deleted assets still inside the trash window

200.description: Soft-deleted assets, most recently deleted first.

post.summary: Restore soft-deleted assets out of the trash

200.description: How many assets were restored. Already-purged or never-deleted IDs simply do not count towards `affected`.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Apply a status transition (publish / unpublish / archive / delete) to many content items

200.description: Per-item outcome. Transitions go through CE's content service, so versions and events match single-item actions. Selections above 50 items return `background: true` and continue asynchronously.

post.summary: Delete many content items (shorthand for the `delete` transition)

200.description: Per-item outcome, identical in shape to `status`. Selections above 50 items return `background: true`.
All environments of the organization — production first, then by sort order — each enriched with its mapped content count.

post.summary: Create a new environment

201.description: The created environment. Marking it production clears the flag on the previous production environment.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

200.description: Environment, alias and content-mapping counts for the organization.
Operation logs newest first, capped by `limit` (default 50).

get.summary: Get a sync log by ID

200.description: The requested operation log.
All aliases of the organization, alphabetically, with their target environment.

post.summary: Create a new alias

201.description: The created alias. `environment_name`/`environment_slug` are not joined in on create.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

200.description: The requested alias with its target environment name and slug.

put.summary: Switch alias to a different environment (atomic)

200.description: The alias after the switch. Re-pointing at the current target is a no-op and returns the joined read shape unchanged.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

200.description: The requested environment, including its mapped content count.
The updated environment.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Seed default environments (production, staging, development)

201.description: The three seeded environments — or the existing ones unchanged when the organization already has any.

200.description: Content mapped into the environment, most recently updated first, with its promotion provenance. The content `data` payload is not included.

post.summary: Assign existing content items to an environment (own-org content only)

201.description: Counts of newly created mappings versus requested IDs that were skipped.

post.summary: Promote a single content item between environments

201.description: Outcome of the promotion, including reference-closure counts. A target edited since the last promotion fails with 409 unless `force` is set.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Sync all content between two environments

201.description: Aggregate sync counts plus the ID of the sync log recording the run.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Compare content between two environments

201.description: One entry per (content type, slug, locale) present in either environment, ordered only_a → only_b → different_version → same_version.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Resolve an alias or env ID/slug to an environment ID

201.description: The resolved environment ID; 404 when nothing matches.

post.summary: Seed default alias (master → production)

201.description: The seeded `master` alias — the existing aliases when any are present, or an empty array when the organization has no production environment yet.

post.summary: Clone an environment (sandbox creation)

201.description: The new sandbox environment plus clone counts. Cloned content slugs get a `--<sandbox-slug>` suffix; collisions are skipped and reported in the sync log.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

200.description: All export jobs of the organization, newest first, each with the creating user's name. Inline `file_content` is included verbatim, so responses can be large.

post.summary: Create an export job (does not run it)

201.description: The created job in `pending` state; POST `jobs/{id}/process` to run it.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

200.description: The requested job. Poll this to watch a background export reach `completed`.

delete.summary: Delete an export job and its stored result

200.description: Deletion acknowledgement; a job that is currently processing cannot be deleted.

post.summary: Run an export job (returns immediately)

202.description: The job as it stood when the run was accepted — rendering happens in the background, so poll the job for its final status, `record_count` and `file_size`. A job that is already processing errors.

200.description: Success. JSON responses are wrapped in the standard envelope: `{ "data": ... }`, with optional `meta` (e.g. pagination) on list endpoints.

meta.description: Optional metadata (pagination, counts) — present on list endpoints

post.summary: Run a template now, creating and processing a job synchronously

201.description: The finished job — named "<template> — <date>" and already processed, so `record_count` and the payload location are populated.

200.description: All templates of the organization — defaults first, then by name.

post.summary: Create an export template

201.description: The created template. Marking it default clears the flag on the previous default for the same format.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

200.description: The requested template.
The template re-read after the update. Setting `isDefault` clears the flag on the previous default for the effective format (IMP-PRO-EXPORT-05).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

200.description: Deletion acknowledgement; jobs the template produced are left in place.
All schedules of the organization, newest first. Delivery credentials are vaulted and never returned — only `secret_ref` is.

post.summary: Create a recurring export schedule

201.description: The created schedule with its first `next_fire_at` computed from the cron. Any `deliverySecret` is vaulted, and creation is refused rather than storing it unencrypted when no vault key is configured.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

200.description: The requested schedule, including its next and last fire times.
The updated schedule. `next_fire_at` is re-armed from now, or nulled when the schedule is disabled.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

delete.summary: Delete an export schedule (and purge its vaulted credential)

200.description: Deletion acknowledgement; the schedule's delivery credential is revoked too.

get.summary: List the run history of a schedule

200.description: The 20 most recent runs, newest first, including failures and delivery targets.

post.summary: Force-run a schedule now (does not change its next fire time)

202.description: Acknowledgement that the run was started in the background. Poll `schedules/{id}/runs` for the outcome and the delivery target.

200.description: All import jobs of the organization, newest first, each with the creating user's name. Inline `file_content` is included verbatim, so responses can be large.

post.summary: Create an import job (does not start it)

201.description: The created job in `pending` state. Unknown content types and a `duplicateKey` no mapping produces are rejected here rather than at run time.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get one import job, including its progress stats and error log

200.description: The requested job. Poll this while a job is processing to watch `stats` advance.

delete.summary: Delete an import job (imported content is left in place)

200.description: Deletion acknowledgement. Deleting a job that is currently processing is refused — cancel it first.

post.summary: Start processing a pending import job (returns immediately)

202.description: The job just after it was claimed (status `processing`). Rows are imported in the background — poll the job to follow `stats`. A job that is not `pending` errors, so a duplicate POST cannot double-import.

post.summary: Cancel a pending or processing import job

201.description: The job after the cancel request. A pending job goes straight to `cancelled`; a processing one is flipped to `cancelling` and finalises within one progress batch.

post.summary: Re-run a completed or failed import job

201.description: Final counters of the synchronous re-run. `failedOnly` (default) skips rows already imported; `failedOnly: false` drops the tracking rows and re-imports everything.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Roll back an import, deleting the content (and assets) it created

201.description: What the rollback removed. Any per-item failure leaves the job in `rollback_partial` and the rollback re-invocable.

post.summary: Dry-run the field mapping on the first records of a file

201.description: Per-row mapping and validation results for the previewed slice, plus the total record count and any auto-detected source options. Nothing is written.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Generate a preview token for draft content access

201.description: The created token record plus a ready-to-use `previewUrl` — the only response that carries the token secret.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

200.description: Page of tokens (newest first) plus the total matching count.
The requested token record; 404 when unknown to the organization.
Revocation acknowledgement — the token stops validating immediately.

delete.summary: Clean up expired and revoked tokens

200.description: Number of token rows removed.

get.summary: Get draft content by ID using a preview token

200.description: The draft content, if the token scope allows it. 401 without a valid token, 404 when out of scope or absent.

get.summary: Get draft content by slug using a preview token

200.description: The draft content matching the slug (and locale, when given or pinned on the token).

get.summary: List draft content available under a preview token

200.description: Page of content the token scope permits (most recently updated first) plus the total count.

post.summary: Create a shareable preview link (optional password + access limit)

201.description: The created link including its public `url`. The password hash is never returned.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

200.description: Page of shareable links (newest first) plus the total matching count.

get.summary: Get shareable link details with analytics

200.description: The requested link with its access and (hashed) visitor counters.
Deletion acknowledgement — the link row and its analytics are removed.
Revocation acknowledgement — the link's expiry is moved to now, the row is kept.

get.summary: Access a shareable preview link (public, optional password)

200.description: The previewed content plus the reviewer-facing link settings. Consumes one access slot. 401 when the link is invalid, expired, exhausted, or the password is wrong.

post.summary: Leave a reviewer comment on a shareable preview (public, token-credentialed)

201.description: ID and timestamp of the stored comment. Commenting does not consume a link access slot.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: List reviewer comments left on a shareable link (org view)

200.description: Comments on the link, newest first; empty array when none were left.

get.summary: Get preview usage statistics (tokens + shareable links)

200.description: Token and shareable-link counters for the organization.

delete.summary: Clean up expired tokens and links

200.description: Rows removed per table — tokens older than 7 days, links older than 30 days.

get.summary: List saved views visible to the caller (own + shared)

200.description: Own views plus views shared with the caller's organization or role — pinned first, then by name. Entries whose config drifted from the content-type schema carry a `drift` block.

post.summary: Create a saved view

201.description: The created view as stored, with defaults applied (`icon: bookmark`, `color: brand`, `share_scope: org`).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: List only pinned views (for the quick-bar)

200.description: Visible pinned views ordered by `pin_order` then name. Drift is not computed on this path.
The default view. `data` is null when the caller set none, or when the previously chosen view is no longer visible to them.
Acknowledgement — the caller's content list falls back to the unfiltered default.

post.summary: Make a view the caller's default (replaces any previous default)

201.description: Acknowledgement. The view must be visible to the caller; a user has at most one default.

200.description: The requested view, with a `drift` block when its config no longer matches the content-type schema. 404 when not visible to the caller.
The updated view. An empty body returns the record unchanged; a non-owner gets 403.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

200.description: Deletion acknowledgement; 404 when the view is unknown or not owned by the caller.

post.summary: Record that a view was applied (usage tracking)

201.description: The view with its incremented `use_count` and refreshed `last_used_at`. A per-user counter is updated alongside it.

post.summary: Duplicate a visible view into a private copy of your own

201.description: The new copy, named "<source> (copy)", owned by the caller and reset to unshared and unpinned.

put.summary: Reorder the pinned quick-bar (atomic, own views only)

200.description: Acknowledgement. All pin orders are written in one transaction — an unknown or foreign ID rolls the whole batch back with 404 (IMP-PRO-SV-03).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code (e.g. BAD_REQUEST, UNAUTHORIZED, NOT_FOUND)

message.description: Human-readable message; validation errors return one message per violation

path.description: Request path that produced the error

requestId.description: Correlation ID (echoes the X-Request-Id header) for support and log lookup

environmentId.description: Environment ID the input resolved to. The input may be an alias name, an alias ID, an environment ID, or an environment slug.

assigned.description: Mappings actually inserted (rows sourced from an org-constrained SELECT, so foreign IDs never count)

skipped.description: Requested IDs that were not mapped — already mapped, foreign, or nonexistent

total.description: Number of content IDs in the request

url.description: Short-lived signed download URL (10 minutes). Null when the host has no storage provider or signing failed. Raw storage keys are never returned (IMP-PRO-BULK-05).

assets.description: One entry per resolved asset, each with its signed URL

totalSize.description: Sum of all resolved asset sizes in bytes

notFound.description: Requested IDs not found in this organization; omitted when empty

assetId.description: ID of the item that failed. Named `assetId` for both asset and content operations — the content bulk service reuses the asset result shape.

error.description: Failure message. Storage failures are prefixed with `storage`.
error.example: storage delete failed for org/abc.jpg: connection reset

found.description: How many of those exist in this organization

totalSize.description: Combined size of the found assets in bytes

mimeTypes.description: Asset count per MIME type; unknown types are keyed `unknown`

folders.description: Asset count per folder ID; unfiled assets are keyed `root`

inUse.description: Assets referenced by content — surfaced so the UI can warn before a destructive delete (IMP-PRO-BULK-02)

id.description: Audit-log entry ID — the handle for undo

entity.description: Kind of record the operation touched

result.description: Per-ID outcome recorded at the time — typically `{ affected, notFound, skipped }`, plus `failed` for content operations. Shape varies by operation.

before_state.description: Before-state snapshot used by undo: one object per changed item, carrying only the fields the operation altered (`{ id, folderId? , tags?, status? }`). Empty for a permanent delete, which cannot be undone.

undone_at.description: When the operation was undone; null while it is still reversible

success.description: Whether the operation completed without per-item errors

affected.description: Items actually changed — not the number requested

errors.description: Per-item failures; omitted entirely when there were none

skipped.description: Assets left alone because content still references them (non-forced delete only, IMP-PRO-BULK-02); omitted when empty

notFound.description: Requested IDs that do not exist in this organization (IMP-PRO-BULK-03); omitted when empty

unchanged.description: IDs the operation left as-is — the tags were already present or already absent; omitted when empty

operationId.description: Audit-log ID; POST it to `ops/{id}/undo` to reverse the operation. Empty string when the log write itself failed, absent on undo/restore responses.

deletedAt.description: When the asset was soft-deleted. The storage object survives until the retention window expires and the purge runs.

success.description: Whether the operation completed without per-item errors

affected.description: Items actually changed — not the number requested

errors.description: Per-item failures; omitted entirely when there were none

skipped.description: Assets left alone because content still references them (non-forced delete only, IMP-PRO-BULK-02); omitted when empty

notFound.description: Requested IDs that do not exist in this organization (IMP-PRO-BULK-03); omitted when empty

unchanged.description: IDs the operation left as-is — the tags were already present or already absent; omitted when empty

operationId.description: Audit-log ID; POST it to `ops/{id}/undo` to reverse the operation. Empty string when the log write itself failed, absent on undo/restore responses.

background.description: True when more than 50 items were accepted: the transitions continue in the background, so `affected` is 0 and the real outcome lands in the audit log entry.

alias.description: The stable pointer name consumers use instead of an environment ID

environment_id.description: Environment the alias currently points at

environment_name.description: Name of the target environment. Joined in by the read endpoints; absent on create and on a switch that actually moved the pointer.

environment_slug.description: Slug of the target environment (same availability as `environment_name`)

syncLogId.description: ID of the `pro_sync_logs` row recording the clone

clonedContentTypes.description: Content types visible to the new environment. Content types are org-level and shared, so nothing is duplicated — this is a reporting count.

clonedContent.description: Content items actually copied into the sandbox (0 unless `includeContent`; slug collisions are skipped)

contentTypeId.description: Content type the compared entry belongs to

slug.description: Content slug — part of the comparison key

locale.description: Content locale — part of the comparison key

envA.description: The entry in environment A; null when it exists only in B

envB.description: The entry in environment B; null when it exists only in A

diff.description: How the two sides relate. Results are sorted in this enum order.

brokenRefsA.description: Reference IDs in the environment-A entry whose target is not mapped into environment A (broken references); absent when the entry exists only in B

brokenRefsB.description: Same count for the environment-B entry; absent when the entry exists only in A

contentId.description: Content ID on this side of the comparison

content_type_id.description: Content type ID of the item

source_content_id.description: Content ID this copy was promoted/cloned from; null for items assigned directly to the environment

promoted_from_env.description: Environment ID the item was promoted from; null when never promoted

promoted_at.description: Time of the last promotion into this environment

slug.description: Org-unique slug, lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens

is_production.description: Whether this is the organization's single production environment

api_url.description: Delivery API base URL of this environment, when it has its own

contentCount.description: Content items mapped into this environment. Added by the list and detail reads; absent on create/update/seed responses.

deleted.description: Always true. Deleting a job that is currently processing is refused, and an unknown ID errors, before this is returned.

source.description: Source path in the content record

target.description: Column/key name in the exported output

transform.description: Value transform applied on the way out

createdAfter.description: Only items created at or after this time

createdBefore.description: Only items created before this time

updatedAfter.description: Only items updated at or after this time

updatedBefore.description: Only items updated before this time

search.description: Free-text search term applied to the selection

filters.description: Selection filters; null when the job exports everything

fields.description: Whitelist of fields to include; null means every field

field_mappings.description: Source → target renames and transforms; null means pass-through

status.description: Job state. `expired` means the retention window passed and the payload was dropped — re-run the export (IMP-PRO-EXPORT-03).

file_content.description: The rendered export, inline for small results. Null while pending, once expired, or when the result exceeded the inline limit and went to object storage.

file_key.description: Storage key when the result exceeded `EXPORT_INLINE_MAX_BYTES`; `file_content` is then null (IMP-PRO-EXPORT-04)

file_size.description: Size of the rendered export in bytes; null until it completes

record_count.description: Content items written; null until it completes

expires_at.description: Retention cutoff — the payload is dropped and the job flipped to `expired` past this time; null until it completes

user_name.description: Name of the creating user, joined in by the job reads; absent on the create response and null when the user was deleted

enabled.description: Whether the schedule fires; a disabled one has no next fire time

delivery_type.description: Where a finished export is delivered

delivery_config.description: Non-secret delivery settings — `endpoint`, `bucket`, `region`, `prefix` for S3, `url` for a webhook. Free-form because it varies by delivery type; credentials are never in here.

secret_ref.description: Reference to the vaulted delivery credential. The secret itself never leaves the AES-256-GCM vault and is never returned. Null when delivery needs no credential.

next_fire_at.description: Next occurrence, advanced by compare-and-swap so exactly one node runs each fire; null while disabled

created_by_id.description: User who created the schedule — scheduled runs are attributed to them

job_id.description: Export job the run produced; null when it failed before creating one

record_count.description: Records exported by this run; null unless it succeeded

delivered_to.description: Human-readable destination — the S3 object URL or webhook URL; null for `none` delivery or a failed run

started.description: Always true — the run was started in the background. Poll `schedules/{id}/runs` for its outcome.

filters.description: Selection filters; `{}` when the template exports everything

fields.description: Whitelist of fields to include; null means every field

field_mappings.description: Source → target renames and transforms; null means pass-through

is_default.description: Whether this is the default template for its format (at most one per format)

rowIndex.description: Zero-based position of the offending row in the source file

record.description: The raw source record that failed, as parsed from the file

error.description: Failure message; schema failures list the field-level AJV errors
error.example: Schema validation failed: /headline must be string

deleted.description: Always true; a job that is currently processing cannot be deleted and errors instead

name.description: Job label chosen by the operator

source.description: Source format of the uploaded file

content_type_id.description: Content type every imported row is created as

status.description: Job state. `cancelling` is a cooperative request the row loop honours within one progress batch; `rollback_partial` means some deletions failed and rollback can be re-invoked.

config.description: Import configuration exactly as submitted — `fieldMappings` (target field → source path or a transform object), `slugField`, `skipDuplicates`, `duplicateKey`, `validationMode`, and the source-specific options (`csvDelimiter`, `recordSelector`, `wxrPostTypes`, `markdownBundle`). Free-form because the mapping keys mirror the target content type.

stats.description: Progress counters, rewritten every 100 rows while processing; null until the first batch. After a rollback it also carries a `rollback` sub-object.

error_log.description: Per-row failures recorded by the last run; null before the job ran

file_key.description: Storage key of the uploaded file; null for inline imports

file_content.description: The inline source document, up to 5 MB — returned verbatim by the job reads, so expect large payloads. Null when a `file_key` was used.

locale.description: Locale assigned to every imported item

started_at.description: When processing was claimed; null while pending

user_name.description: Name of the creating user, joined in by the list and detail reads; absent on the create response and null when the user was deleted

slug.description: Slug taken from `config.slugField`; null when unset — the real import then derives one from a title-like field

data.description: The mapped content payload that would be written, keyed by the target content type's fields

rowIndex.description: Zero-based position of the row in the source file

raw.description: The record exactly as the parser read it from the file

mapped.description: Result of applying the field mappings. Async transforms (`asset`, `relation`) are NOT resolved during preview — the raw value stays in place.

valid.description: Whether the mapped payload validates against the content type's JSON Schema

errors.description: Field-level validation or mapping errors; omitted when the row is valid

records.description: The first `limit` records (default 10, max 50), mapped and validated

totalInFile.description: Records the parser found in the whole file, not just the previewed slice

fieldMappingPreview.description: Shorthand list of the mapped `data` payloads, in the same order as `records`

detectedDelimiter.description: CSV sources only: the delimiter in use — the configured one, or the auto-detected one when `csvDelimiter` was left unset (IMP-PRO-IMPORT-05)

availablePostTypes.description: WordPress (WXR) sources only: the post types actually present in the upload, so the picker offers the file's own types (IMP-PRO-IMPORT-06)

assetsDeleted.description: Assets the import had downloaded and that rollback removed. Assets still referenced by other content are kept.

errors.description: Content items that could not be deleted. Their tracking rows survive, so rollback can be re-invoked; the job lands in `rollback_partial` (IMP-PRO-IMPORT-03).

total.description: Records found in the source file

imported.description: Content items created. Cumulative across retries — rows already tracked from an earlier run count here without being re-imported.

skipped.description: Rows deliberately not imported — duplicates, schema-invalid rows under `validationMode: skipInvalid`, or an unresolved relation with `onMiss: skip`

deleted.description: Tokens deleted — expired or revoked and older than 7 days

author_name.description: Name the reviewer gave, truncated to 100 characters; null when anonymous

status.description: Editorial status. Omitted on shareable-link access when the link was created without `showMetadata`.

data.description: The content payload as stored, shaped by the content type's schema. On shareable-link access, paths listed in the link's `redactFields` are stripped server-side.

_preview.description: Marker that this payload came from the preview path, never the delivery API

_previewScope.description: Scope of the token that authorised the read

_previewToken.description: First 8 characters of the token, for support correlation

items.description: Content readable under the token, most recently updated first

total.description: Total items readable under the token

deleted.description: Always true; deleting an unknown ID is a no-op

revoked.description: Always true; revoking an unknown ID is a no-op

totalTokens.description: Preview tokens ever created for the organization

totalAccesses.description: Sum of all link access counts

uniqueVisitors.description: Sum of hashed unique-visitor counts across links with tracking enabled

id.description: Preview token ID (the token secret itself is never returned)

contentId.description: Content the token is bound to; set for `content` scope

contentTypeId.description: Content type the token is bound to; set for `content_type` scope

locale.description: Locale the token is restricted to; null means any locale

isExpired.description: Whether `expiresAt` is already in the past

isRevoked.description: Whether the token was explicitly revoked

lastUsedAt.description: Last successful validation; null when never used

previewUrl.description: Ready-to-use preview URL carrying the token secret

items.description: Tokens on this page, newest first

promoted.description: Always true — a failed promotion raises instead

targetContentId.description: Content ID of the copy in the target environment (created or updated)

syncLogId.description: ID of the `pro_sync_logs` row recording this promotion

previousStatus.description: Status the target copy had before the promotion; null when the copy was newly created

newStatus.description: Status of the target copy after promotion — promoted content always lands as draft

forced.description: Whether `force` was needed because the target had been edited after the last promotion

cascaded.description: Referenced entries promoted alongside the root as part of the reference closure (0 unless `includeReferences`)

remappedReferences.description: Entries whose copied `data` had reference IDs rewritten to target-environment IDs

skippedReferences.description: Referenced entries left untouched — the target copy had newer edits and no `force` was given

cleared.description: Always true; clearing when no default was set is a no-op

default.description: Always true — the view is now the caller's default

deleted.description: Always true; a non-owned or unknown ID yields 404 instead

staleColumns.description: Column keys in the view's config that the content type no longer declares

staleFilters.description: Filter keys that no longer match a field of the content type

user_id.description: User who created the view and is its only editor

name.description: View name as shown in the picker

icon.description: Icon key rendered next to the name

color.description: Colour token for the view chip

config.description: Persisted list state — `viewMode`, `sortBy`, `sortOrder`, `pageSize`, `search`, `columns[]`, `filters{}` and `contentTypeId`. Free-form by design: the filter block mirrors whatever fields the content type declares.

is_shared.description: Whether other users can see the view at all; false keeps it private

share_scope.description: Who a shared view reaches — the whole organization, or only holders of `share_role` (IMP-PRO-SV-02)

share_role.description: Role the view is shared with; required when `share_scope` is `role`

is_pinned.description: Whether the view appears in the quick-bar

use_count.description: Times the view was applied. On a shared view this counter aggregates all users; per-user counts live in `pro_saved_view_user_state`.

drift.description: Schema-drift report (IMP-PRO-SV-04) — present only when the config references fields the content type no longer has. Computed on read, never stored, and omitted on write responses.

reordered.description: Always true — the reorder is transactional, so any rejected ID fails the whole batch with 404 instead

url.description: Public preview URL including the link token

hasPassword.description: Whether a password is required (the hash is never returned)

maxAccesses.description: Access cap; null means unlimited within the expiry window

isExpired.description: Whether `expiresAt` is already in the past

locale.description: Locale the preview is pinned to; null means the content default

showMetadata.description: Whether status and created/updated timestamps are exposed to the reviewer

customMessage.description: Note shown to the reviewer on the preview page

redactFields.description: Dot-paths stripped from `data` server-side before the preview is returned (IMP-PRO-PREV-07)

watermark.description: Watermark text rendered by the public preview page; null means none

visitorTracking.description: Whether opt-in visitor analytics are enabled. Only per-link salted hashes are stored — never raw IPs (IMP-PRO-PREV-01).

uniqueVisitors.description: Distinct visitors counted via those hashes

items.description: Links on this page, newest first

content.description: The previewed content, already redacted and metadata-filtered

customMessage.description: Note the link creator left for the reviewer

accessesRemaining.description: Accesses left before exhaustion; null when the link is uncapped

visitorTracking.description: Whether hashed visitor analytics are on. The consuming page MUST show a data-processing notice when true (IMP-PRO-PREV-01).

watermark.description: Watermark text to overlay on the preview; null means none

syncLogId.description: ID of the `pro_sync_logs` row recording this sync

failed.description: Items whose promotion threw (logged, not fatal)

total.description: Source-environment items matching the type/status filters

initiated_by.description: User who started the operation; null once that user is erased — the log survives (IMP-PRO-ENV-07)

items_total.description: Items the operation set out to process

items_failed.description: Items that failed or were skipped

content_type_filter.description: Content type IDs the operation was restricted to; null means all types

error.description: Failure message when status is `failed`; also carries the forced-overwrite note on a successful forced promotion
